name: codex-harness-adapter
description: 在 Codex 桌面端连接各种 harness

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix packages/claude && npm ci --prefix packages/pi && npm ci --prefix packages/dsh && npm ci --prefix packages/opencode && npm ci --prefix packages/acp && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/claude && npm run build --prefix packages/pi && npm run build --prefix packages/dsh && npm run build --prefix packages/opencode && npm run build --prefix packages/acp && npm run build --prefix packages/device && node scripts/build-cli.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix packages/claude && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/pi && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/dsh && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/opencode && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/acp && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/device
scripts.check: biome check packages apps scripts && node scripts/check-versions.mjs && node scripts/check-manual.mjs && node scripts/check-text-sizes.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix packages/claude && npm run test --prefix packages/pi && npm run test --prefix packages/device && go test ./...
scripts.test:compat: npm run build && node --import ./packages/claude/dist/claude/test/fixtures/isolate-process.mjs --test --test-force-exit packages/claude/dist/claude/test/upstream-compat.test.mjs && node --import ./packages/pi/dist/pi/test/setup.mjs --test packages/pi/dist/pi/test/upstream-compat.test.mjs packages/pi/dist/pi/test/upstream-validator.test.mjs && node --test packages/device/dist/device/test/upstream-compat.test.mjs
scripts.check:background-client-tools: npm run build --prefix packages/device && npm run build --prefix packages/pi && npm run build --prefix packages/claude && node scripts/check-background-client-tools.mjs
scripts.check:manager-fixture: npm run build && node --test scripts/client-fixture-manager.test.mjs && node scripts/check-manager-fixture.mjs
scripts.check:pair-cli: node --test scripts/fixture-environment.test.mjs && node scripts/build-cli.mjs && node scripts/check-pair-cli.mjs
scripts.test:dsh-ssh: npm run build --prefix packages/dsh && node scripts/dsh-poc-serve.mjs --verify
scripts.client:setup: npm ci --prefix packages/ui && npm ci --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix packages/core && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/ui && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:build: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run build --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:start: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run start --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:start:mock: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run start:mock --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:smoke: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run smoke --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:smoke:entry: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run smoke:entry --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:check:scroll: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run check:scroll --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:check:scroll:entry: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run check:scroll:entry --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:check:compose: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run check:compose --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:check:compose:entry: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run check:compose:entry --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:check:local: npm run stage:adapter --prefix apps/desktop && npm run check:local --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:check:remote: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run check:remote --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:check:full: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run check:full --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:check:manage: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run check:manage --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:check:tasks: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run check:tasks --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:check:onboard: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run check:onboard --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:check:harness-settings: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run check:harness-settings --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:check:sidebar: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run check:sidebar --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:check:manager: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run build --prefix apps/desktop && node apps/desktop/scripts/smoke.mjs --manager
scripts.client:check:manager-real: npm run build && npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run build --prefix apps/desktop && node apps/desktop/scripts/check-manager-real.mjs
scripts.client:check:tree: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run check:tree --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:check:background: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run check:background --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:check:background-tools-real: npm run build --prefix packages/device && npm run build --prefix packages/pi && npm run build --prefix packages/claude && npm run client:build && node apps/desktop/scripts/check-background-tools-real.mjs
scripts.client:check:goal: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run check:goal --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:check:terminal: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run check:terminal --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:check:files: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run check:files --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:check:diff: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run check:diff --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:check:settings: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run check:settings --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:check:text-scale: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run check:text-scale --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:check:engines: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run check:engines --prefix apps/desktop --
scripts.client:check:first-turn: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run check:first-turn --prefix apps/desktop --
scripts.client:shots: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run shots --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.client:pack: npm run build --prefix packages/ui && npm run pack --prefix apps/desktop
